data.gender_notes: Sharvee is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharvee is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Shree’, which means prosperity, wealth and good fortune. The suffix ‘Vee’ in Sharvee signifies the goddess of love, Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, arts, wisdom and learning. Thus, Sharvee is a beautiful name that embodies love, grace and prosperity. The name Sharvee carries the meaning “Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvee usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is believed to be blessed by the Goddess of Love, Saraswati. It signifies that the girl is divine, graceful, and full of love and knowledge.
data.etymology: Sharvee belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvee total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
